candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method sets the new password and updates the user but never invalidates existing sessions. The user's sessions (refresh tokens) are not deleted, so devices that were already signed in can still refresh their tokens after the reset. The upstream implementation calls sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) after the update.

fix.description: In AuthService.resetPassword, after `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);` call `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` to revoke all sessions so every device must sign in again. Ensure SessionService is injected in AuthService.
